sentences.en: Existing legislation does not take diversity of races into account.
sentences.zh: 现有的法律并未考虑到种族多样性。

sentences.en: I just admire the diversity of life on our planet.
sentences.zh: 我只钦佩我们星球上生命的多样性。

sentences.en: They have stated their aim is to destroy linguistic diversity.
sentences.zh: 他们表示其目标是消灭语言多样性。

senses.zh: 多样性：variety, multiformity；分歧，不同点：different

mnemonic: 词根记忆：di（分开）+vers（转）+ity →转开了→不同的→多样
